extension.summary: One Pace version of One Piece
extension.description: One Pace is a fan-made recut project that edits the official One Piece anime to match the pacing of the original manga more closely. It cuts out non-canon filler, extended auras/beam clashes, and repetitive reactions. Shorter and faster, it condenses multiple original episodes into streamlined blocks, saving dozens (or hundreds) of hours across heavy arcs like Dressrosa and Wano.[CR]Watch One Pace in Kodi through your debrid service or peer to peer as configured via the settings and the onepace website.[CR]If using a peer-to-peer setup, it's aways recommended you use a VPN.
